newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends lower on harvest, weak cash prices.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends lower on harvest, weak cash prices.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower in consolidation trading with some pressure coming from the escalation of the U.S. rice harvest, traders said.
"Harvest is coming on and gaining momentum with quality and yield very impressive," a trader said.
A soft undertone to the U.S. cash market also contributed pressure as did a "little hedge pressure," he said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 300 contracts, up from 267 Thursday, according to the CBOT.
Rice futures closed two to four cents per cwt lower, with September down three at $10.32 per cwt.
Rice options volume was estimated at 50 contracts, up from 28 Thursday.
